Population increased in Newcastle-under-Lyme

The estimated population of Newcastle-under-Lyme in 2024 was 127,727 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Newcastle-under-Lyme's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Newcastle-under-Lyme increased by 3.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Newcastle-under-Lyme was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Newcastle-under-Lyme

The average (median) age fell to 42.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Newcastle-under-Lyme has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Newcastle-under-Lyme is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Newcastle-under-Lyme's population of 127,727 usual residents was made up of:

  • 20,622 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.1%)
  • 79,373 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.1%)
  • 27,732 people aged 65 years and over, (21.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Newcastle-under-Lyme has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Newcastle-under-Lyme, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Newcastle-under-Lyme
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Newcastle-under-Lyme, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 372 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 1,021 births and 1,393 deaths in Newcastle-under-Lyme.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 975 (0.8%). There were 9,455 people entering the area and 8,480 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Newcastle-under-Lyme's population of 824 (0.7%) as a result of 1,230 people entering the area and 406 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Newcastle-under-Lyme was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Newcastle-under-Lyme in mid-2023 is 126,282.

Within this, international migration was revised downwards by 70 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,708 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 1,778 people.
